prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Delivery is a humorous low-poly third person game with cute bean-eyed miniature villagers, yellow-helmet courier, tan houses and green plants. Create a wide screenshot mockup with the game action taking 90 percent of attention. Show elderly male and female NPCs facing a courier, standing center in a sunny toy-like street. UI must feel like IN-GAME CONVERSATION, not a messaging app, not a chat log or large window. NPC woman has one small high-contrast dark translucent speech bubble beside/above her head saying 比就比，我可不让他！ Underneath small thin key prompt T. At the LOWER LEFT edge show only a compact quiet dialogue input area, about 33% image width and 20% image height. Borderless charcoal translucent backing fading into scene, off-white clean typography, one muted sage accent. Within it: tiny label 对翠花说, full readable player utterance 你：大壮就在旁边，你俩到底谁更厉害？, a slim single white-tinted input field placeholder 说点什么… and small understated 发送 button. Below input, tiny text link 找点话题 and right Enter 发送 · Esc 收起. All content is fully readable with restrained spacing. No full transcript, no tall panel, no bright colors, no colored anger/apology buttons, no emoji, no boxed name bar, no website styling. On the FAR RIGHT of this design sheet, show a SMALL inset detail with an optional expanded suggestions area only: label 可以挑拨、比试，也可以劝和, two plain selectable lines 你俩到底谁更厉害？敢不敢比划两下？ / 刚才是我多嘴了，别打了。, helper 选中复制后，可以改成自己的话. The inset is clearly a UI detail, not a second persistent overlay. Favor the scene and characters; minimalist atmospheric game UI that can be built from editable Unreal UMG widgets. High quality crisp Chinese typography. The in-game dialogue is the star, not the interface.
